# `r tx("rep_sec_table1")`

```{r table1, results='asis'}
t1 <- table_one(a, by = by)
shown <- t1[, setdiff(names(t1), c("variable")), drop = FALSE]
shown$label[duplicated(shown$label)] <- ""
names(shown)[1:2] <- c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("tbl_statistic"))
knitr::asis_output(paste0(
  html_table(shown), "\n\n<p class='small text-muted'>",
  html_escape(tx("rep_note_tests")), "</p>\n\n"))
```

# `r tx("rep_sec_quality")`

```{r missing, results='asis'}
m <- missing_summary(a)
m <- m[m$n_missing > 0L, c("label", "n_missing", "pct_missing"), drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(m) == 0L) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n", html_escape(tx("rep_missing_none")), "\n\n"))
} else {
  names(m) <- c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("tbl_missing"), "%")
  knitr::asis_output(html_table(m))
}
```

```{r outliers, results='asis'}
o <- outlier_summary(a)
o <- o[o$n_outliers > 0L, c("label", "n_outliers", "lower", "upper", "values"), drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(o) > 0L) {
  o$lower <- fmt_num(o$lower, 1L)
  o$upper <- fmt_num(o$upper, 1L)
  names(o) <- c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("col_n_outliers"), tx("col_lower"), tx("col_upper"),
                tx("col_values"))
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n<h3>", html_escape(tx("ana_outlier_title")), "</h3>\n\n",
                            html_table(o), "<p class='small text-muted'>",
                            html_escape(tx("ana_outlier_note")), "</p>\n\n"))
}
```

# `r tx("rep_sec_prev")`

```{r prev, results='asis'}
p <- tryCatch(prevalence_table(a, by = by), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(p) && nrow(p) > 0L) {
  p$ci <- sprintf("%.1f - %.1f", p$ci_low, p$ci_high)
  shown <- p[, c("label", "group", "n", "N", "pct", "ci")]
  names(shown) <- c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("col_group"), "n", "N", tx("col_prev"), tx("col_ci"))
  knitr::asis_output(html_table(shown))
}
```

```{r prevfig, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.2, out.width = "90%"}
pp <- tryCatch(plot_prevalence(a, by = by), error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(pp)) print(pp)
```

```{r bivariate-head, results='asis'}
if (length(outcomes) > 0L) knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n# ", tx("rep_sec_bivariate"), "\n\n"))
```

```{r bivariate, results='asis', fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 6, out.width = "90%"}
for (o in outcomes) {
  say("\n\n## ", a$labels[[o]], "\n\n")
  ct <- tryCatch(compare_continuous(a, o), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(ct)) {
    shown <- ct[, setdiff(names(ct), "variable")]
    shown$p_value <- vapply(shown$p_value, function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else if (x < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", x), "")
    names(shown)[c(1, ncol(shown) - 2L, ncol(shown) - 1L, ncol(shown))] <-
      c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("tbl_missing"), tx("col_test"), tx("col_p"))
    cat(html_table(shown))
  }
  cc <- tryCatch(associations_categorical(a, o), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cc) && nrow(cc) > 0L) {
    cc$ci <- ifelse(is.na(cc$or), "", sprintf("%.2f - %.2f", cc$ci_low, cc$ci_high))
    cc$or <- ifelse(is.na(cc$or), "", sprintf("%.2f", cc$or))
    cc$p <- vapply(cc$p_value, function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else if (x < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", x), "")
    shown <- cc[, c("exposure_label", "compared", "n", "test", "or", "ci", "p")]
    names(shown) <- c(tx("col_exposure"), tx("col_compared"), "n", tx("col_test"),
                      tx("col_or"), tx("col_ci"), tx("col_p"))
    cat(html_table(shown))
  }
}
```

```{r corr-head, results='asis'}
if (length(biomarkers) >= 2L) knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n# ", tx("rep_sec_corr"), "\n\n"))
```

```{r corr, results='asis', fig.width = 7, fig.height = 6, out.width = "80%"}
if (length(biomarkers) >= 2L) {
  cr <- tryCatch(correlations(a, biomarkers), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(cr)) {
    shown <- cr[, c("label1", "label2", "method", "n", "r", "p_value", "p_adj")]
    shown$r <- sprintf("%.3f", shown$r)
    for (k in c("p_value", "p_adj")) shown[[k]] <- vapply(shown[[k]], function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else if (x < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", x), "")
    names(shown) <- c(tx("col_exposure"), tx("col_exposure"), tx("col_method"), "n", tx("col_r"), tx("col_p"), tx("col_p_adj"))
    cat(html_table(shown))
  }
  pc <- tryCatch(plot_correlation(a, biomarkers), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(pc)) print(pc)
}
```

```{r reg-head, results='asis'}
if (length(outcomes) > 0L && length(predictors) > 0L) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n# ", tx("rep_sec_regression"), "\n\n"))
}
```

```{r regression, results='asis', fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 4.5, out.width = "85%"}
if (length(outcomes) > 0L && length(predictors) > 0L) {
  for (o in outcomes) {
    m <- tryCatch(logistic_model(a, o, predictors), error = function(e) e)
    say("\n\n## ", a$labels[[o]], "\n\n")
    if (inherits(m, "error")) { say("*", conditionMessage(m), "*\n\n"); next }
    for (nt in m$notes) say("* ", nt, "\n")
    f <- m$fit
    say("\n\n", sprintf("n = %d, %s = %d. Nagelkerke R2 = %s; Hosmer-Lemeshow p = %s; AUC = %s.",
                          f$n, tx("col_events"), f$events,
                          if (is.na(f$nagelkerke)) "-" else sprintf("%.3f", f$nagelkerke),
                          if (is.na(f$hl_p)) "-" else sprintf("%.3f", f$hl_p),
                          if (is.na(f$auc)) "-" else sprintf("%.3f (%.3f - %.3f)", f$auc, f$auc_low, f$auc_high)),
        "\n\n")
    mt <- model_table(m)[, c("label", "crude_or", "crude_ci", "crude_p", "adj_or", "adj_ci", "adj_p")]
    for (k in c("crude_or", "adj_or")) mt[[k]] <- ifelse(is.na(mt[[k]]), "", sprintf("%.2f", mt[[k]]))
    for (k in c("crude_p", "adj_p")) mt[[k]] <- vapply(mt[[k]], function(x) if (is.na(x)) "" else if (x < 0.001) "<0.001" else sprintf("%.3f", x), "")
    names(mt) <- c(tx("tbl_variable"), tx("col_crude_or"), tx("col_ci"), tx("col_p"), tx("col_adj_or"), tx("col_ci"), tx("col_p"))
    cat(html_table(mt))
    if (nrow(m$terms) > 0L) print(plot_forest(m))
  }
}
```

```{r roc-head, results='asis'}
if (length(outcomes) > 0L && length(biomarkers) > 0L) {
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("\n\n# ", tx("rep_sec_roc"), "\n\n"))
}
```

```{r roc, results='asis', fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5, out.width = "90%"}
if (length(outcomes) > 0L && length(biomarkers) > 0L) {
  rt <- tryCatch(roc_biomarkers(a, outcomes, biomarkers), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(rt) && nrow(rt) > 0L) {
    shown <- rt
    shown$ci <- sprintf("%.3f - %.3f", shown$ci_low, shown$ci_high)
    shown$auc <- sprintf("%.3f", shown$auc)
    for (k in c("cutoff", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv")) shown[[k]] <- sprintf("%.2f", shown[[k]])
    shown <- shown[, c("outcome_label", "biomarker_label", "n", "events", "auc", "ci", "interpretation", "cutoff", "sensitivity", "specificity", "ppv", "npv")]
    names(shown) <- c(tx("col_outcome"), tx("col_biomarker"), "n", tx("col_events"), tx("col_auc"), tx("col_ci"), tx("col_interp"), tx("col_cutoff"), tx("col_sens_pct"), tx("col_spec_pct"), tx("col_ppv"), tx("col_npv"))
    cat(html_table(shown))
    print(plot_auc_heatmap(rt))
    for (o in unique(rt$outcome)) print(plot_roc(rt, o))
  }
}
```
